description: The second arm of the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:93-103 taken with a FULLY POPULATED communication area, driven at the SERVICE level: MainMenuService is constructed and called as a plain object, with no MockMvc, no servlet container and no JobLauncher anywhere in the path (gate G51). The case does two jobs that only fit together on this route. First, it is the one case in the directory where CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM arrives ALREADY NAMING A DIFFERENT PROGRAM, so the unconditional assignment at line 97 is proved to discard it. Second, it is the directory's full 160-byte COMMAREA round trip, which is the primary evidence for gate G37 and rule R6. The trace. Line 77 SET ERR-FLG-OFF TO TRUE and lines 79-80 MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COMEN1AO. Line 82 IF EIBCALEN = 0 is FALSE - a 160-byte area is passed, which is what EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM('COMEN01C') COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:237 hands a regular arrival - so line 86 MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA copies it in. Line 87 IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is FALSE because the inbound CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1, which is the 88 CDEMO-PGM-REENTER value at app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:31, so line 88 SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and line 89 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COMEN1AO are both skipped and line 92 PERFORM RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN runs instead. The EVALUATE at line 93 is ordered: DFHENTER first, DFHPF3 second, WHEN OTHER last, and the second arm matches here (gate G30). Line 97 MOVE 'COSGN00C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM - TO, where line 83 writes FROM - and line 98 PERFORM RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN. Inside that paragraph line 172 IF CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES OR SPACES is an abbreviated combined relation: the subject is repeated, so it reads 'equal to LOW-VALUES or equal to SPACES'. It is FALSE, because line 97 has just written eight characters into the field, so LINE 173 IS NOT EXECUTED. Lines 175-177 EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) then transfer with NO COMMAREA, which is exactly the condition the sign-on program's own EIBCALEN = 0 test is looking for, and the target travels as a nextProgram response field rather than as a server-side forward (gate G40). The overwrite is the decisive assertion. CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM arrives holding COCRDLIC, a live program name and a plausible leftover from an earlier leg of the conversation: COCRDLIC is the program of menu option 3, 'Credit Card List', at app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:37-41, and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:357-358 defines TRANSACTION(CCLI) PROGRAM(COCRDLIC), which is why CDEMO-TO-TRANID arrives holding CCLI beside it. Line 97 overwrites the field regardless, so the expectation is COSGN00C and NOT the inbound value. An implementation that honoured a caller-supplied target - which reads like the considerate thing to do - fails this case, and that is the point: line 97 is source behaviour and is preserved rather than repaired (practice B5). It is also the reason line 173 can never fire from this arm; case18 is the only case in the directory that reaches the line 173 default, and it reaches it from line 83 with an un-VALUEd area on the EIBCALEN = 0 route. case14 takes this same DFHPF3 arm but carries COMEN01C in CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and leaves the other fourteen fields at their initialised images, so all three cases agree that COSGN00C is the target and differ in how they get there and in what they carry while doing it. The round trip is the second assertion, and it is why every field of the area is populated with a recognisable value rather than left blank: a field that arrives at its initialised image cannot show that it survived. app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44 declares the area as CDEMO-GENERAL-INFO of CDEMO-FROM-TRANID X(04) 4 bytes, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM X(08) 8, CDEMO-TO-TRANID X(04) 4, CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM X(08) 8, CDEMO-USER-ID X(08) 8, CDEMO-USER-TYPE X(01) 1 and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 9(01) 1, which is 34; CDEMO-CUSTOMER-INFO of CDEMO-CUST-ID 9(09) 9, CDEMO-CUST-FNAME X(25) 25, CDEMO-CUST-MNAME X(25) 25 and CDEMO-CUST-LNAME X(25) 25, which is 84; CDEMO-ACCOUNT-INFO of CDEMO-ACCT-ID 9(11) 11 and CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS X(01) 1, which is 12; CDEMO-CARD-INFO of CDEMO-CARD-NUM 9(16) 16; and CDEMO-MORE-INFO of CDEMO-LAST-MAP X(7) 7 and CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET X(7) 7, which is 14. The five groups sum to 34 + 84 + 12 + 16 + 14 = 160, and the sixteen field widths sum to the same 160, so a reviewer can confirm the total by eye without a copybook parser (practice B11). Every value below is written to its full declared width: a PIC X image is space-padded on the right, exactly as a COBOL alphanumeric MOVE into a wider receiver pads, and a PIC 9 image is zero-filled on the left to its whole digit count, which is why CDEMO-CUST-ID reads as nine digits, CDEMO-ACCT-ID as eleven and CDEMO-CARD-NUM as sixteen (practice B8). Fifteen of the sixteen fields must come back byte-identical, and each has its own reason. CDEMO-FROM-TRANID and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM: lines 147-148 do write them, from WS-TRANID and WS-PGMNAME, but both statements sit inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, which this arm never performs, so CC00 and COSGN00C - the transaction and program that transferred control here - survive. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT stays 1: line 151 MOVE ZEROS TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is in the unreached dispatch block and line 88 SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is in the unreached first-entry branch. CDEMO-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-TYPE stay ADMIN001 and A because lines 149-150, the two MOVEs that would have assigned them, are COMMENTED OUT in the source; they stay commented out here too (practice B5), so the identity the sign-on program put in the area is the identity that comes back. CDEMO-TO-TRANID, the three customer name fields, CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS and CDEMO-CARD-NUM are referenced NOWHERE in the 282 lines of app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl - confirmed by exhaustive search - so they must survive untouched including their padding. CDEMO-LAST-MAP and CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET are the one deliberate exception to the populate-everything rule, and the reason is recorded rather than glossed over (practice B4). The program never writes either field, so whatever arrives comes back; but the directory's own service invariant asserts positively that both are blank on every path, which distinguishes the program's own map identity - stated only where a SEND actually ran - from the conversation's record of it. They are therefore supplied as the seven spaces an unset PIC X(7) span holds, and the round trip is still asserted for them at their full declared width. All sixteen fields are pinned, none is omitted, and no value is left to a default (practice B1). The identifiers are not invented. CDEMO-CARD-NUM 0923877193247330, CDEMO-CUST-ID 000000002 and CDEMO-ACCT-ID 00000000002 are one row of app/data/ASCII/cardxref.txt read as its copybook declares it - CARD-NUM X(16) then CUST-ID 9(09) then ACCT-ID 9(11) - so the three are a genuinely cross-referenced triple rather than three unrelated numbers. Enrico, April and Rosenbaum are the first, middle and last names of customer 000000002 in app/data/ASCII/custdata.txt, and Y is the ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS that account 00000000002 carries in app/data/ASCII/acctdata.txt. ADMIN001 with user type A is the first administrator of the security file's seed data, which is where an administrator reaching this menu would have been identified. Statelessness, gate G37 and rule R6. CICS is pseudo-conversational, so the migration carries the conversation in the request and the response payload and keeps no server-side session, and this case is the directory's strongest evidence of that for three reasons. Everything the unit needs arrives in the payload: the sixteen area fields, the attention identifier and the screen's OPTIONI value, with nothing read from a session, a cache, a static field or a dataset - COMEN01C declares no SELECT and no FD and performs no file input or output at all. Everything the caller needs in order to continue comes back in the payload: the whole 160-byte area plus the nextProgram field, and the client, not the server, performs the transfer. And the unit holds nothing between invocations: MainMenuService must have NO STATIC MUTABLE STATE and no assignable instance field, because WS-ERR-FLG, WS-MESSAGE, WS-OPTION and WS-IDX are WORKING-STORAGE, which under CICS is per-task, and as fields of a shared bean they would leak the first caller's values into the second (practice B9). Two successive runs of this case must produce identical outcomes in either order, and a third run against a freshly constructed instance must produce the same outcome again. Because exactly one field is mutated while fifteen pass through, the case simultaneously proves the translation neither wholesale-copies nor wholesale-rebuilds the area: it changes precisely the one field the source changes. What does NOT run. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is not performed, so lines 117-125 never scan or normalise OPTIONI, line 125 never echoes OPTIONO, the option guard at lines 127-134 never evaluates, the authorisation filter at lines 136-143 never reads the option table, and the dispatch block at lines 145-165 - including the other transfer, at lines 152-155, which does pass a COMMAREA - is never reached. OPTIONI is supplied as the two spaces a blank screen field carries, at the PIC X(2) width app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:132 declares, and is NOT CONSULTED on this arm; it is declared so the invocation is complete rather than because the value matters. SEND-MENU-SCREEN is not performed either, so POPULATE-HEADER-INFO paints no header and BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS composes no line: 'sends' is empty, and the twelve OPTN00nO lines and the echoed OPTIONO are therefore left entirely unpinned rather than pinned as the painted cases assert them. nextMapset and nextMap are omitted for the same reason - no SEND MAP occurs, and neither XCTL names a map, since line 153 names CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION) and line 176 names CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, both of them programs - so naming COMEN01 and COMEN1A here would tell the client to paint the screen this program is leaving. Nothing is said. WS-MESSAGE is PIC X(80) at line 38, blanked at line 79 and never overwritten on this route, so the emitted line is declared on the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel as eighty spaces: a positive statement that no message was produced, not an omitted key. It is deliberately the 80-byte working-storage image and not the 78-byte screen field, because line 187 MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO sits inside SEND-MENU-SCREEN and never executes here; that two-byte narrowing is case16's subject, and a 78-byte expectation on this channel would be compared against something the service does not produce and would break gate G18. No farewell text is emitted either: PF3 is exactly the key at which a courteous sign-off would be invented, and COMEN01C contains no such literal anywhere - CCDA-THANK-YOU is in the copybook but this program never moves it - so inventing one would be a new feature. Nothing is highlighted and nothing may be: COMEN01C does not copy CSSETATY, the red colour mnemonic appears nowhere in its 282 lines, red reaches the screen only as ERRMSG's declared COLOR in app/bms/COMEN01.bms, and the single attribute byte the program ever writes is the green override of line 158 on the option-acknowledgement path this case never reaches. No attribute is pinned, because there is no send to carry one, and gate G38 is honoured through the ENTER and REENTER pairing rather than through a highlight: this is the REENTER half, and it produces no error output at all. The error flag is off, since only line 100 and line 130 raise it and neither runs. expectedReturnCode is 0 because COMEN01C is reached by CICS transaction CM00 - defined at app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:399-400 - rather than by EXEC PGM=, contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and sets no RETURN-CODE, so gate G35 has no subject here, and the program contains no GO TO (G32) and no arithmetic verb (G22 to G29) either. 'inputs', 'expectedWrites' and 'expectedFinalState' are empty because the program performs no dataset access whatsoever, which also leaves gates G19, G21 and G47 without a subject; no width normalisation is declared, because no dataset is seeded to normalise. Determinism, practice B7. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:33, the instant the program's own version footer at app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:281 carries, and every case in this directory pins that same instant so one clock governs the whole gate. POPULATE-HEADER-INFO does not run on this arm, so no CURDATE or CURTIME is produced and the pinned instant changes nothing this case asserts; it is declared for uniformity and the fact that it is unused here is recorded rather than left to be inferred. The code page is named explicitly as US-ASCII and is never a platform default, so the byte semantics of every image above are stated rather than assumed. There is no wall-clock read, no randomness and no locale-dependent formatting anywhere in the case. The security posture is unchanged, practice B6. The user identifier and the user type travel in the payload and are neither looked up in the security file nor re-verified nor hashed on this route, and there is no server-side session to invalidate on the way back to sign-on. No credential appears anywhere in this fixture: no dataset is seeded, so the legacy plaintext password span is not present at all, and the carried identity fields are neither stripped nor masked, because the program carries them verbatim. Gates pinned: G15 as one of the twenty cases, G18 through a diff count that must be zero, G30 as the second arm of the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID, G37 as the directory's primary statelessness evidence, G40 as an XCTL target delivered in a response field, and G51 by driving the service directly. No user-specified rules exist for this project - review_rules returns exactly 'No user rules provided.' - so enterprise practice governs instead, and nothing here is relaxed on that account. Every expected value above is STATICALLY DERIVED: read out of the COBOL paragraph that produces it and cross-checked against the 160-byte layout of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions of app/bms/COMEN01.bms, the transaction and program definitions of app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD and the real fixture rows of app/data/ASCII. NONE OF IT WAS CAPTURED FROM AN EXECUTION OF THE LEGACY PROGRAM, which is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and the three IBM-supplied copybooks DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository, which is why common.CicsAid is the single reproduction of the attention identifiers and why the DFHPF3 mnemonic is named here rather than a raw byte typed out (risk R-D). The substitution of provenance is escalated for confirmation rather than absorbed (risk R-A).
